resources.string: Film. Encrypt. Upload. Nothing stays on the phone.

Every photo and video is encrypted on this phone with the server\'s public key, sent as soon as there is a network, then deleted here. Nobody can view it on the phone — not even you. Only the server operator can decrypt it, offline.
Check this fingerprint with the organiser. Your recordings will only ever be readable with this key.
The key matches the QR code. Your recordings will only ever be readable with this key.
The server\'s key does not match the QR code. Do not use this network.
The server\'s key has changed since you joined it. Nothing is sent. Ask the organiser before scanning its QR code again.
This QR code is not a Témoin enrollment code.
Continuous: keeps recording with the screen locked, short segments, restarts by itself.
Camera and microphone access are needed to record.
Phone storage almost full: recording stopped.
1080p uses about twice the storage and data (≈2.3 GB per hour instead of ≈1.1 GB) and takes twice as long to upload on a busy mobile network. Use it only when you need the detail.
This server only accepts up to %1$dp.
USB-C (UVC) cameras show up here when your phone supports them (most Android 14+ phones). Bluetooth cannot carry video; Wi-Fi action cams are not supported yet.
Adds GPS position inside the encrypted file. Off by default.
%1$d encrypted objects are still waiting. They can only be sent to this server: forgetting it deletes them.

Media never touches the storage unencrypted: frames are encoded and encrypted in memory, in segments of a few seconds, with the server\'s public key (age / X25519). This phone has no key to decrypt them. Segments are uploaded as soon as possible and deleted after the server confirms them.
Enter the invitation code given by the organiser.
Unknown invitation code. Check it with the organiser.
This invitation has expired. Ask the organiser for a new one.
This invitation has been revoked. Ask the organiser for a new one.
This invitation has already been used by the maximum number of phones.
This phone has been banned from this server.
This phone has been banned by the server operator. Nothing is sent; your recordings stay encrypted on the phone in case the ban is lifted.
The server no longer knows this phone. Scan a new invitation to join it again.
Server unreachable — figures from the last connection.
This phone has its own key for this server. The server only knows this pseudonym, never who you are.
Wrong address or invitation code: the server did not answer.
Unlock the phone to set up Témoin.

Your videos and photos can only be read by the organizer. Ask for them: you get a code to pass on (in person, SMS, Signal…). They will send you, through another channel, a one-time link to save them on any phone, even without this app.
Code to give to the organizer
The organizer will send you a link. It opens only once: open it on the device where you want to keep the files.
Waiting: the link is not ready yet.
Link ready: the organizer has to send it to you.
Link opened: save the files on the device that opened it.
Last link expired without being opened.
Last link cancelled by the organizer.
